title: HB2407 level 0, file selection and calibration mapping

recipe.name: processing_lvl_0_calibration
recipe.description: Raw file selection and the survey's calibration mapping (gs:// inputs).

nodes.label: inputs.raw_input_folder
nodes.description: Folder containing the raw acoustic files (local path or gs:// URL).

nodes.label: inputs.calibration_outputs
nodes.description: Subdirectory name under the pipeline outputs folder for calibration artifacts.

nodes.label: inputs.raw_file_names
nodes.description: Optional subset of filenames within raw_input_folder to use. Empty list means "use every .raw file in the folder".

nodes.label: inputs.file_time_start
nodes.description: Optional inclusive ISO datetime restricting processing to raw files whose filename-encoded time (D{YYYYMMDD}-T{HHMMSS}) is at or after this bound. Applied to both the processed file set and the calibration scan; leave unset to process every file. This bound also sets the fan-out width: one mapped instance per selected file.

nodes.label: inputs.file_time_end
nodes.description: Optional inclusive ISO datetime upper bound; see file_time_start.

nodes.label: inputs.cal_input_folder
nodes.description: Folder containing manufacturer calibration files (local path or gs:// URL).

nodes.label: inputs.cruise_id
nodes.description: Cruise identifier used in calibration mapping.

Validate the raw file set in the input directory, create calibration output directories if they do not exist, and return a list of raw file paths and the resolved calibration output directory ready for processing.

params.name: raw_input_folder
params.description: Folder containing .raw files. May be a local path or a remote fsspec URL (e.g. gs://bucket/survey/raw); remote folders are listed without downloading any data, and existence checks are skipped at validation time for remote URLs.

params.name: calibration_outputs
params.description: Subdirectory name under the pipeline's user-facing outputs folder where calibration artifacts are written. Resolved automatically relative to the outputs directory when run via the executor; treated as a CWD-relative path when called standalone (e.g. in a notebook). Calibration JSON logs are always written to a logs/ subdirectory within this folder.

params.name: raw_file_names
params.description: Explicit file name list; empty means include all files in folder

params.name: clear_previous_json_logs
params.description: Delete the calibration_flags.json left by a previous run before this one starts, so the flags reflect this run alone. Set false to let the flags accumulate across runs.

params.name: file_time_start
params.description: Optional inclusive ISO datetime (e.g. "2016-07-25T20:58") restricting the raw file set to files whose filename-encoded time (D{YYYYMMDD}-T{HHMMSS}) is at or after this bound. Filenames without a parseable datetime are excluded when a bound is set. Applies to local and gs:// folders alike; filtering is name-based, so no data is read (or downloaded) to filter.

params.name: file_time_end
params.description: Optional inclusive ISO datetime upper bound for filename-encoded file times. See file_time_start.

outputs.name: raw_file_paths
outputs.description: Ordered list of absolute paths to raw acoustic files

outputs.name: calibration_output_dir
outputs.description: Resolved full path to the calibration outputs directory. Pass this to generate_standardized_cal_mapping as output_base.

nodes.description: Read manufacturer calibration files, convert them to per-channel standardized files, match each raw channel to its calibration data, and return a mapping dict and a calibration dict.

params.name: raw_input_folder
params.description: Folder containing raw acoustic files; used to determine channel configuration. May be a local path or a remote fsspec URL (e.g. gs://bucket/survey/raw). Remote raw files are scanned one at a time: each is downloaded to local scratch, read for its channel config, and the local copy deleted before the next file is fetched.

params.name: cal_input_folder
params.description: Folder containing manufacturer calibration files (.cal / .xml). May be a local path or a remote fsspec URL; a remote folder is downloaded to a local scratch directory for the duration of the parse (these files are small) and removed afterwards.

params.name: output_base
params.description: Root directory the standardized calibration files, mapping files, and logs are written under. Normally wired to ${initial_setup.calibration_output_dir} so calibration artifacts land beside the run's other outputs. Subdirectories are created as needed.

params.name: cruise_id
params.description: Cruise identifier recorded in every generated single-channel calibration file (e.g. "HB1603"), so a standardized file stays traceable to the survey it came from.

params.name: record_author
params.description: Name recorded as the author of every generated single-channel calibration file. Part of the provenance the standardized format carries, not something the calculation uses.

params.name: short_filenames
params.description: Use compact names for the generated single-channel files and the keys in mapping_dict. Set false for fully descriptive names, which are easier to read and longer.

params.name: keep_unused
params.description: Retain standardized files not matched to any channel

params.name: conflict_resolution
params.description: 'error' or 'interactive' when multiple cal files match a channel

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print progress information during mapping; implementation-specific

params.name: file_time_start
params.description: Optional inclusive ISO datetime restricting the scanned raw files to those whose filename-encoded time (D{YYYYMMDD}-T{HHMMSS}) is at or after this bound. Should match the initial_setup window so the channel-configuration scan covers exactly the files being processed. For remote folders the filter is applied before any file is downloaded.

params.name: file_time_end
params.description: Optional inclusive ISO datetime upper bound for filename-encoded file times. See file_time_start.

outputs.name: mapping_dict
outputs.description: Maps each raw channel to its standardized calibration file path

outputs.name: calibration_dict
outputs.description: Parsed standardized calibration data keyed by channel
